# Copilot instructions

- Keep changes focused on the team's agreed hackathon project and challenge requirements.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes and explain assumptions when requirements are unclear.
- Use available project checks and tests before calling a change complete.
- Do not add API keys, passwords, personal information, or other secrets to files or terminal output.
- Treat external datasets and API responses as untrusted input; document sources and respect their usage terms.
- Update the README when setup or run instructions change.
